'''David Kaye''' (born, '''David V. Hope'''; October 14, 1964) is a Canadian voice actor. He is best known for his work animation and gaming, notably remembered for voicing Sesshomaru in ''{{wp|Inuyasha}}'', {{wp|Ratchet and Clank (characters)|Clank}} in the ''{{wp|Ratchet & Clank}}'' video game series, various characters in several animated shows based on the ''{{wp|Ben 10}}'' and ''{{wp|Transformers (franchise)|Transformers}}'' franchises, and the announcer of ''{{wp|Last Week Tonight with John Oliver}}'' on {{wp|HBO}}. In the [[Pokémon]] franchise, he voices [[Gibeon]] in the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|HZ}}.
